entities.name: Anton
entities.description: A green and white planeswalker who dueled Karshan on at least three occasions.

entities.name: Karshan
entities.description: Planeswalker who battled Anton for dominion over the Multiverse and defeated him with a goblin raiding band and juggernaut.

entities.name: Scryb sprites
entities.description: Forest sprites summoned by Anton in his final duel.

entities.name: Great Plains
entities.description: Location of Anton's cottage, destroyed by stone rain.

events.summary: Anton and Karshan fight three duels for dominion over the Multiverse.
events.quote: Anton battled Karshan for dominion over the Multiverse

events.summary: In the final duel Anton's cottage is destroyed by stone rain; he summons a colossal spider and the Scryb sprites but falls to Karshan's goblin raiders and juggernaut.
events.quote: he fell to Karshan's goblin raiding band and juggernaut

events.summary: Anton prefers dying to watching Karshan rule and swears his spirit will reclaim what was his.
events.quote: Anton preferred dying over watching Karshan rule over the Multiverse.

relations.note: Rivals in three duels for dominion of the Multiverse.
relations.quote: Anton battled Karshan for dominion over the Multiverse
he fell to Karshan's goblin raiding band and juggernaut
